scope: Full tracked checkout; static catalogue/domain declaration inventory and targeted registration/session/lifecycle authorization, message transaction/archive dispatch, delivery cursor, reservation transaction/publication/replay, slot grant, release recovery boundary, HTTP role/browser guard, external Beads query, TUI registry and selected test assertion review. Not every-line audit, complete background reconciliation/intent replay, crypto proof, controller mathematics, search, repair framework, installer or live usability certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Mailbox project and self-asserted agent registration; optional proof gate, token rotation and opt-in session binding; no task creation in mailbox model or included Beads read dispatcher
lifecycle_review.select: Ready/list/show/status readers delegate to external Beads issue authority; no atomic issue-plus-resource selection/claim transaction
lifecycle_review.claim: Nonconflicting file paths selected, active-agent and overlap rechecked inside immediate transaction; keyed result committed with leases; foreground guard JSON required for successful admission; build slots remain report-and-grant advisory
lifecycle_review.progress: Mail creation plus recipients/idempotency result in database transaction; post-commit notifications and best-effort archive publication; no execution checkpoints or attempt result authority
lifecycle_review.review: Message receipts and registration identity proofs do not establish task acceptance or qualified reviewer approval
lifecycle_review.complete: No mailbox task completion gate; external issue system must check delivered revision, criteria and children
lifecycle_review.cancel: Reservation release and authenticated identity retirement/deregistration change coordination state; no worker process cancellation
lifecycle_review.recover: Ordered retained delivery cursors with explicit loss/ahead errors, optional keyed mutation replay, guard publication errors/reconciliation boundaries, queued ACK/release intents, observed-expiry forced release and temporal release cutoffs; no task-attempt fencing
